visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white oversized shirt and a dark skirt, is kneeling on a dark pavement outside at night. She is using a thick black marker to carefully write large Chinese characters on a long, bright yellow poster board. The area is bordered by lush green bushes and a large tree trunk, illuminated by artificial night lights. (2) The camera moves slightly as she continues her work, writing the word "蛋蛋" (Dandan) and drawing a pink heart. Nearby on the ground, a smartphone and a plastic cup containing a yellow beverage are visible. The woman is focused on her task, wearing a black face mask that partially covers her profile. (3) The scene shifts abruptly to a brightly lit concert stage inside a massive indoor arena. A man with short hair, wearing a black t-shirt and grey tactical pants, stands in the center of the stage holding a microphone. He faces a dense crowd of thousands of fans who are holding up glowing phone lights, creating a shimmering effect. (4) The yellow poster board from the first scene is held up in the audience. The performers on stage, including a man in a white sports jersey and a blue cap, look toward the sign and point at it. The stage is filled with technical equipment, and large screens in the background show live feeds of the performance. (5) The camera captures close-up shots of the performers interacting and laughing. They point at the sign and talk to the audience, creating a humorous atmosphere. The lighting is dominated by warm orange and white spotlights that sweep across the stage and the enthusiastic crowd.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A studio-produced hip-hop beat begins immediately, featuring a deep synthesized bassline and a crisp 808 snare. The tempo is moderately fast, creating a rhythmic and energetic background. No speech is present in this initial phase, as the sound focuses on the instrumental track accompanying the visual of writing. (2) A hard cut occurs, and the studio music transitions into a live concert environment. The soundscape is suddenly dominated by a massive, cheering crowd with high-frequency whistles and applause. A male voice, booming through a large PA system, begins to speak with high arousal, though the clarity is slightly affected by room reverb. (3) The primary speaker (Big Duo) addresses the audience with an authoritative yet humorous tone. His speech rate is moderate, and he uses dramatic pauses to let the crowd react. A slight hum of low-frequency ambient arena noise is constant under his voice. (4) A second male voice (Kenzy) joins the dialogue, speaking with a sharper, more playful inflection. The two engage in quick banter, accompanied by several short bursts of loud laughter from the crowd. The rhythmic BGM of the concert continues at a low volume in the background. (5) The performers continue their funny exchange, leading to a collective shout of '蛋蛋啦' from the performers and the crowd. The phase concludes with the speakers laughing and making mock-apologetic remarks, while the overall noise level of the crowd remains very high.
